newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS ups Newcourt to positive outlook.
newsitem.headline: CBRS ups Newcourt to positive outlook.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said it raised its credit rating outlook for Newcourt Credit Group Inc to positive from stable.
The Montreal-based ratings agency said changed its outlook for Newcourt after the financial group's latest results.

"The rating outlook change reflects Newcourt's increasing profitability and interest coverage ratios," CBRS said in a statement. "Some of the company's strengths expanding industry and geographic spread, its low leverage, its diversified funding sources and its close ties to institutional investors (primarily major life insurance companies) which fund its loan origination activities and are involoved in its credit policies and major financing transactions.
CBRS currently rates Newcourt's commercial paper at A-1 (low) and medium-term note programs at A (low).
